Profile Menu Account card with the signed-in user, menu actions and profile setup progress. $ pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://www.affectui.com/r/profile-menu-clean.json Preview Code Copy prompt MCP Copy Lena Hartmann lena.hartmann@fastmail.com Settings Docs Apps New Logout Profile setup 3/5 Next: Add a profile photo When to use The dropdown behind the avatar in an app header Nudging people to finish their profile, right next to the account actions When not to use Long menus with nested levels – use a full dropdown menu with submenus Long onboarding flows with many steps – use a checklist like the Setup Guide instead Installation Add Profile Menu with the shadcn CLI – your project needs a components.json, see Installation in the docs – or copy the file by hand. Requires React 19. CLI Manual pnpm npm yarn bun Copy pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://www.affectui.com/r/profile-menu-clean.json Usage example.tsx Copy import { ProfileMenu, SettingsIcon, LogoutIcon } from "@/components/ui/profile-menu-clean"; export function Account() { return ( , onSelect: openSettings }, { id: "logout", label: "Logout", icon: , onSelect: signOut }, ]} setup={{ done: 3, total: 5, next: "Add a profile photo", onContinue: openProfile }} /> ); } API reference ProfileMenu Prop Type Default Description name string – Name of the signed-in user email string – Email under the name, cut off with an ellipsis when long avatar ReactNode – Replaces the default avatar, e.g. an items ProfileMenuItem[] – Actions with label, icon, optional badge and onSelect setup ProfileSetup – Profile setup progress: done, total, the next step and onContinue – leave empty to hide className string – Extra class on the card Keyboard interactions Tab Move into the menu ↑ or ↓ Move between the actions Home or End Jump to the first or last action Enter or Space Run the focused action Accessibility Actions are buttons in a menu role, so screen readers announce them as menu items The setup bar is a progressbar with its percentage as value Motion The setup bar fills up when the card comes into view Reduced motion shows it at once Responsive behavior Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually ) has the class dark or data-theme="dark" Related Progress Tracker Feedback Onboarding checklist with an animated progress bar, ticks that draw themselves and auto play affectUI · 54 components · 12 screens · 11 blocks · 24 illustrations · 8 motion effects affectUI Agent-ready React UI for AI products – one file each, no dependencies.
